out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Post the 2026 health department permit as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection. The permit should be posted where customers can see it at all times.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. There was no certified food manager present at the start of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a certified food manager during all hours of operation. A CFM arrived before the inspection concluded. CDI.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. The manager could not locate a vomit and diarrhea cleanup policy.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. The inspector provided the manager with a copy of the model Fairfax County policy. CDI.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. The certified food manager arrived for work during the inspection, but failed to wash hands before serving a customer.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. The inspector discussed this with the employee. The employee washed her hands. CDI.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed food in two of the handwashing sinks, indicating that they were being used to dump waste.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Do not use handsinks to dump foods. The inspector spoke to the manager about this. CDI.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: there were several pieces of food contact equipment such as stainless steel inserts and blender caps on the clean equipment storage shelving which were not clean and were visibly soiled with food debris.
violations.corrective_action: Properly clean and sanitize all food contact equipment after use. The manager cleaned all the equipment during the inspection.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: food in the Ikon prep top refrigerator were not cold enough. Cashew milk was 47°, yogurt was 50°, cocoa whip was 57°.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Products were discarded. Other TCS foods in the unit were moved to another refrigerator which was working properly. CDI.

out_items.name: Food additives; approved and properly used

violations.title: Approved Additives
violations.observation: Food offered for service or sale contains the following unapproved food additives or additives at unapproved levels: bee pollen.
violations.corrective_action: Food may not contain unapproved food additives or additives that exceed amounts specified in 21 CFR 170-180 relating to food additives, generally recognized as safe or prior sanctioned substances that exceed amounts specified in 21 CFR 181-186, substances that exceed amounts specified in 9 CFR Subpart C Section 424.21(b) Food ingredients and sources of radiation, or pesticide residues that exceed provisions specified in 40 CFR 180 Tolerances for pesticides chemicals in food, and exceptions. The inspector asked how the bee pollen is served and the food employees said they add it directly to products. The inspector told them that is not permitted, and that the bee pollen can’t be added directly to the product, but must be offered separately in individual cups. The employees said they understood and would comply. Please ensure that all employees are properly trained in how to serve bee pollen.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. There were two unlabeled spray bottles in the prep area. The employee said they contained cleaning and sanitizing chemicals.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. The employee labeled both bottles during the visit. CDI.

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. The CFM was not wearing a hair restraint while preparing foods.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. The inspector discussed this with the manager.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Several stainless steel and plastic food pans were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. The inspector discussed this with the manager. PLAYA BOWLS (Inspection Date: 01/14/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Utensils Maintained in Good Repair
violations.observation: The following utensil was observed in a state of repair and condition preventing effective maintenance and cleaning/sanitization: there was a badly cracked blender pitcher in the clean equipment storage shelving.
violations.corrective_action: Utensils shall be maintained in a state of repair or condition that complies with the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2 or shall be discarded. Discard the cracked blender as it is no longer easily cleanable.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the icon two door broken refrigerator was not keeping food cold enough. The ambient temperature was 58°F. There was ice build up on the inside of the unit, which is most likely affecting its cooling ability.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Have the refrigerator serviced. Contact your inspector when it is capable of keeping food cold again.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: the insides of the freezers behind the line.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Clean the insides of the freezers as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Design Features
violations.observation: The backflow or backsiphonage prevention device installed on the mop sink in the restroom is not identified as meeting standards set by the American Society of Sanitary Engineering. The splitter attached to the mopsink faucet is not an approved type.
violations.corrective_action: A backflow or back siphonage prevention device installed on a water supply system shall meet American Society of Sanitary Engineering (A.S.S.E.) standards for construction, installation, maintenance, inspection, and testing for that specific application and type of device. The inspector provided the manager with a picture of an approved device, a Hydro Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve, which she said she would order an install. Please notify the inspector after the new device is installed.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed there was no hot water at the hand sink in the back of the establishment. The hot water shut off valve was closed. According to the manager, the sink had recently been repaired.
violations.corrective_action: Hot water must be provided at all handwashing sinks. The manager turned on the hot water during the inspection.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM at start of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM arrived during the inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at both hand sinks.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC provided paper towels to each hand sink

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cashew milk (62F), almond milk (74), coconut milk (71) on the top of 4 drawers flat-top.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded all TCS food items under ambient temperature.

out_items.name: Food additives; approved and properly used

violations.title: Approved Additives
violations.observation: Food offered for service or sale contains the following unapproved food additives or additives at unapproved levels: bean pollen.
violations.corrective_action: Food may not contain unapproved food additives or additives that exceed amounts specified in 21 CFR 170-180 relating to food additives, generally recognized as safe or prior sanctioned substances that exceed amounts specified in 21 CFR 181-186, substances that exceed amounts specified in 9 CFR Subpart C Section 424.21(b) Food ingredients and sources of radiation, or pesticide residues that exceed provisions specified in 40 CFR 180 Tolerances for pesticides chemicals in food, and exceptions. EHS instructed PIC to provide the employees training on correct procedures of offering bean pollen to the customers. Bee pollen will be provided in a small container for self-service.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Handled Utensils Storage
violations.observation: Ice scoop was stored with handle in contact with ice.
violations.corrective_action: The ice scoop shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees. PIC placed the ice scoop by handle up.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 DR Ikon prep cooler observed at 46 F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Please repair the 2 DR Ikon prep cooler to maintain cold food at or below 41F. PLAYA BOWLS (Inspection Date: 02/21/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Receptacles, Location
violations.observation: There is no refuse container at the hand sink at the back of facility.
violations.corrective_action: A receptacle shall be provided in each area of the food establishment or premises where refuse is generated or commonly discarded, or where recyclables or returnables are placed. Please provide the trash can for the hand sink.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the wall (existing hole) and floor (missing tiles) by 1 DR Ikon Freezer are not maintained in good repair. Observed there is not hot water at the hand sink of service area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Please, provide the repair of the wall and floor by 1DR Ikon Freezer and hand sink at the service area.
